name: Eventek KPS305D Variable DC Bench Power Supply (30V/5A)
description: Up for grabs is a precise, highly reliable lab partner for your workshop! This Eventek KPS305D Variable DC Bench Power Supply delivers a continuously adjustable 0-30V voltage and 0-5A current output. Perfect for circuit prototyping, electronics repairing, DIY testing, 3D printer calibration, or phone maintenance. It features crisp dual digital LED displays alongside individual Coarse and Fine adjustment knobs to easily lock in your exact electrical parameters. Designed with a built-in smart temperature-controlled cooling fan and comprehensive safety protection protocols (over-voltage, short-circuit, and overload limits). Compact, lightweight, and functions flawlessly!
contact_note: Includes the power supply unit and US power cord. Fully tested, clean, and in perfect working order. Ready for porch pickup!
meta_description: Pre-owned Eventek KPS305D variable DC bench power supply (30V 5A) in good condition. Features dual LED display, coarse & fine tuning, smart cooling fan.
name_zh: Eventek KPS305D 可调式直流稳压维修实验电源 (30V/5A)
